notes.title: Update 03/23 - 0.15.3
notes.notes:
Hello there ! I just find this option to publish update of my devellopment ːsteamhappyː
I'm not a "social network fan" kinda guy, but I will try to publish my changelog here whenever I have a new version.
Game is not available for the moment, but I will make a demo for the steam survival / open world festival ! So stay tuned until may ːsteamhappyː

Here is my last changelogs :
